titulo: As Andy Burnham enters No 10, what of his ‘bezzie mate’ Steve Rotheram?
cuerpo: A longstanding bromance means the Liverpool regional mayor very much has the ear of the soon-to-be PM When a new prime minister enters Downing Street, observers usually look to those around the cabinet table to see where influence lies. With Andy Burnham, they should look 200 miles north – not to Manchester, but Liverpool. Steve Rotheram, the mayor of Liverpool city region, may not have a formal role in government but he has a strong claim to having the closest personal bond to the incoming prime minister, a man he calls his “bezzie mate”.
